about: Splice is an artistic puzzler where exploration and experimentation are key. Rearrange strands of cells to match target sequences, all the while discovering the rules of their world — and perhaps, something deeper.
* Simple elements that combine for deep complexity
* Answers to the eternal questions of life, the universe, and everything
Video output in Full HD 1080p requires 1080p native display.
